def get_char_pos(seg):
    red_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] >= 50]
    if not red_nodes:
        return None
    all_rows, all_cols = [], []
    for n in red_nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_rows.append(p[0])
            all_cols.append(p[1])
    return (min(all_rows), max(all_rows), min(all_cols), max(all_cols))

# Current position
pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
print(f"Current: rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")

# Go UP to reach Position H (top-left)
for i in range(5):
    result = action(['UP'])
    pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
    cells = last_action_result['executed_actions'][0]['animation']['total_cells_changed']
    print(f"UP {i+1}: cells={cells}, rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")
    if cells <= 5:
        print("  (blocked)")
        break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print("Level completed or game over!")
        break

# Now try RIGHT from Position H
if not last_action_result.get('level_completed') and not last_action_result.get('game_over'):
    for i in range(10):
        result = action(['RIGHT'])
        pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
        cells = last_action_result['executed_actions'][0]['animation']['total_cells_changed']
        print(f"RIGHT {i+1}: cells={cells}, rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")
        if cells <= 5:
            print("  (blocked)")
            break
        if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('game_over'):
            print("Level completed or game over!")
            break

# Check final state
pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
print(f"\nFinal: rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")
print(f"Level: {current_frame.level}")
print(f"Step: {current_frame.step}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
